notes.zh-CN: 新增 Trae Agent 支持（内置 ACP 桥接）与飞书设置分区、一键保存并连接。本次同时提供 macOS 通用版、Windows x64/ARM64（未签名）与 iOS/Android 包：APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名、只能安装到开发团队已注册的设备。
notes.en: Trae Agent support via a built-in ACP bridge, a reorganized Feishu settings section and one-click save-and-connect. This release ships macOS universal, Windows x64/ARM64 (unsigned) and iOS/Android builds; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed, so it only installs on devices registered with the development team.
